data.one_liner: A collection of e‑commerce widgets and utilities for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready‑made UI components such as product grids, coupon cards, and checkout flows, along with helper extensions for colors, dates, and networking. It integrates with material_ui and cupertino_ui for a consistent look across platforms.
use_when: You need a quick start for an e‑commerce app
You want pre‑built widgets that follow Material and Cupertino design
You prefer a single package that bundles UI and utilities
avoid_when: You require a lightweight dependency set
You need full control over every UI element
data.setup_notes: Add inspireui to pubspec, run flutter pub get. No build_runner needed.
